neighbours.label: Objects from space burning up or breaking apart (burn up, disintegrate, comets break up); other things those objects do stay quiet. Rewriting and changing text also fires more weakly and is not tested
fire: The fireball burned up high over Spain.
Small asteroids disintegrate in the upper atmosphere.
The comet broke up as it neared the Sun.
Space debris burns up on reentry.
The old satellite disintegrated during reentry.
Astronomers watched the comet break apart.
Most shooting stars burn up before landing.
A rocket stage broke up over the Pacific.
quiet: The fireball glowed high over Spain.
Small asteroids orbit in the outer system.
The comet brightened as it neared the Sun.
Space debris circles on a low orbit.
The old satellite transmitted during reentry.
Astronomers watched the comet pass by.
Most shooting stars appear before dawn.
A rocket stage fell into the Pacific.

short: space objects burning up or breaking
